newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Moderate quake shakes northern Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Moderate quake shakes northern Philippines.

text.p: A moderate earthquake shook the northern Philippines on Thursday evening but there were no reports of casualty or damage, government seismologists said.

The tremor at 6:38 p.m. (1038 GMT) registered a magnitude of 5.6 on the Richter scale and was centred 17 kms (10.5 miles) northeast of northern San Fernando town, La Union province, the Volcanology and Seismology Institute said.
Seismologist Romy Tabanlar said the quake was not strong enough to cause any casualty or damage except possibly on weakly built structures near its epicentre.
